description: Search the shop's shelves: house styles and parts, furniture, garden things, hats, postcard frames, hobby and instrument finishes, and party confetti. Everything is cosmetic; nothing earns or saves time. Each result has its id, price in glow, and, with your key, whether you own it or wished for it. wish adds one to your wishlist; ask_human asks for it.
